performance.title: Performance
performance.description: These metrics show how well the page performed during the load and how quickly it became interactive.
performance.manualDescription: These checks open in a new tab. They don't affect your score but may highlight opportunities to improve your app's capabilities.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: These checks ensure your site is accessible to all users.
accessibility.manualDescription: These checks open in a new tab. They don't affect your score but may highlight opportunities to improve your app's accessibility.

best-practices.title: Best Practices
best-practices.description: We've compiled the most important issues the web should follow.
best-practices.manualDescription: These checks open in a new tab. They don't affect your score but may highlight opportunities to improve your app's compliance with web best practices.

seo.title: SEO
seo.description: These checks ensure your site is optimized for search engines.
seo.manualDescription: These checks open in a new tab. They don't affect your score but may highlight opportunities to improve your app's search engine optimization.

pwa.title: Progressive Web App
pwa.description: These checks validate the aspects of a Progressive Web App.
pwa.manualDescription: These checks open in a new tab. They don't affect your score but may highlight opportunities to improve your app's compliance with Progressive Web App best practices.

first-contentful-paint.title: First Contentful Paint
first-contentful-paint.description: First Contentful Paint marks the time at which the first text or image is painted. [Learn more about the First Contentful Paint metric](https://web.dev/fcp)

largest-contentful-paint.title: Largest Contentful Paint
largest-contentful-paint.description: Largest Contentful Paint marks the time at which the largest text or image is painted. [Learn more about the Largest Contentful Paint metric](https://web.dev/lcp)

cumulative-layout-shift.title: Cumulative Layout Shift
cumulative-layout-shift.description: Cumulative Layout Shift measures the movement of visible elements within the viewport. [Learn more about the Cumulative Layout Shift metric](https://web.dev/cls)

time-to-interactive.title: Time to Interactive
time-to-interactive.description: Time to Interactive is the amount of time it takes for the page to become fully interactive. [Learn more about the Time to Interactive metric](https://web.dev/tti)

service-worker.title: Service worker
service-worker.description: Registering a service worker is the first step toward creating a Progressive Web App that works offline. [Learn more about service workers](https://web.dev/service-workers-cache-storage)

installable-manifest.title: Web app manifest meets installability requirements
installable-manifest.description: Your web app manifest contains the required properties to display your app as a standalone app. [Learn more about web app manifests](https://web.dev/add-manifest)

offline-start-url.title: Start URL doesn't respond with a 200 when offline
offline-start-url.description: A service worker alone isn't enough to make your app work offline. A web app manifest is also required. However, if your start URL responds with a 200 when offline, your PWA is installable. [Learn more about start URLs](https://web.dev/offline-fallback-page)
